lines.text: On the Sabbath, Jesus' disciples picked figs, and the Pharisees said it was unlawful.
Jesus said the Sabbath was made for man, and the Son of Man is Lord of it.
In the synagogue, people watched to see if Jesus would heal a withered hand, and they stayed silent.
Jesus restored the man's hand, and the Pharisees plotted with the Sadducees to kill Him.
